definition: Every backend Onyx reply is bound to the authenticated profile and the backend's private, active-profile-only personality context.

replyProof.profile: onyx.chat.profileKey must equal the expected authenticated profile, or establish it when the client begins in shared/unknown state
replyProof.model: onyx.chat.aiBrain must equal true and response text must be non-empty

hardRules: Message text cannot select, impersonate, or switch the active profile.
Relationship language and relational tone come from the active profile's private server-side dossier.
Private context from one profile never appears in the other profile's reply.
Shared material is used only when explicitly shared and relevant.
The public frontend stores fingerprints and invariants, never the private dossier text.

localProvider.reason: The optional Ollama adapter does not receive private backend profile context and must remain neutral.
